scope: Classic HUD carried-object list bound directly to canonical DemoState.inventory

source_evidence.README.TXT: left HUD box lists carried objects with arrow-key scrolling

runtime_rules: DemoState.inventory is the only inventory source of truth
remove_inventory removes the item from the HUD immediately
save/load roundtrip restores the same HUD-visible inventory
unknown inventory ids are not rendered as invented player-facing labels
arrow Up/Down scroll input is reserved for the inventory list when scrolling is possible
inventory text uses source INVFONT fixed 10x12 cells; first codepoint 35
inventory scrolling must not consume cursor-key movement input
pass_requires: rusty_tongs appears after acquire and disappears after remove
r8_lens appears after acquisition and disappears after R8_LENS_PLACE
save/reset/load restores the same visible inventory labels
DemoState canonical payload remains the save/load source
